profile.title: Birthcode Profile
profile.subtitle: A structured snapshot generated from your birth input.
profile.intro: Astrology is used here as a symbolic structure, a map of patterns rather than prediction. Personality descriptions are grounded in modern psychology so symbolic astrology and evidence-based psychological language can work together in one readable framework.
profile.bigThreeIntro: The Big Three is your complete astrological profile: Sun, Moon, and Ascendant.
profile.bigThreeLayeredIntro: It is a neutral map of three layers: direction, emotional regulation, and first-contact style.
profile.ascendantDescription: First-impression layer and how you enter relationships.
profile.degreeHelp: How to read Early / Mid / Late
profile.shareSubtitle: Choose a report action for this profile.
profile.disclaimer: This content is reflective and educational, not medical or psychological advice.

info.bigThreeMessage: Sun shows your core identity, Moon shows your emotional style, and Ascendant shows how you naturally approach people and situations.
info.dominantMessage: Elements describe energy style, modalities describe action style, and the dominant one is the strongest repeated pattern in your chart.
info.degreesMessage: A placement is inside a sign from 0.00° to 29.99°. Birthcode shows this as Early, Mid, or Late, with exact degree shown as secondary detail.

info.planetsMessage: Planets represent different psychological functions. Each one appears in a sign and degree that colors how it behaves.
info.ascendantMessage: Ascendant is your outer approach style and the first impression you naturally give.
info.aspectsMessage: Aspects are geometric relationships between planets. Orb is how close the aspect is to exact, with smaller orb being tighter.
info.degreesMessage: Degrees run from 0.00° to 29.99° in each sign. Birthcode shows this as Early, Mid, or Late for easier reading.

premium.dailyBody: Daily prompts and practices that refresh over time.

element.fire:
You gain momentum through action and visible goals.
Fast starts help you move from doubt into progress.
You perform best when challenge and purpose are clear.
element.earth:
You gain confidence through structure and repeatable routines.
Practical planning helps turn ideas into results.
Steady pacing protects quality and consistency.
element.air:
You gain momentum through conversation and perspective shifts.
Mental variety keeps motivation high.
Clear communication turns complexity into decisions.
element.water:
You gain clarity by naming emotional truth first.
Intuition guides timing and relationship choices.
Recovery and reflection keep your decisions grounded.

modality.cardinal:
You are strongest when initiating and setting direction.
Leadership grows when you define clear first steps.
Early structure prevents scattered effort.
modality.fixed:
You are strongest when committing deeply and following through.
Consistency helps you build long-term trust.
Planned flexibility prevents rigidity under pressure.
modality.mutable:
You are strongest when adapting and integrating feedback.
You can reframe quickly and keep momentum in change.
Clear closing routines prevent unfinished loops.

definitions.title: Definitions
definitions.subtitle: A simple guide to the terms used across Birthcode.
definitions.bigThreeSun: Sun: your core identity and self-expression style.
definitions.bigThreeMoon: Moon: your emotional needs and inner processing style.
definitions.bigThreeAsc: Ascendant: your outward style and first impression pattern.
definitions.degreesText1: Each sign has 0.00° to 29.99°. Degrees show where a placement sits inside the sign.
definitions.degreesText2: In app labels: Early (0-9.99), Mid (10-19.99), Late (20-29.99).
definitions.planetsText1: Planets describe different parts of your personality and behavior.
definitions.planetsText2: Ascendant describes your approach style and social entry point.
definitions.planetsText3: Aspects are angular relationships between planets.
definitions.planetsText4: Orb is how close the aspect is to exact alignment.
definitions.insightsText: Insights are reflection prompts to help you think clearly.
definitions.practicesText: Practices are short exercises to turn reflection into action.
